title: Molecular dynamics and structural analysis of the binding of COP1 E3 ubiquitin ligase to beta-catenin and TRIB pseudokinases.
authors: Zahid, Sana; Basharat, Saba; Fakhar, Muhammad; Rashid, Sajid
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究COP1 E3连接酶与beta-catenin及TRIB假激酶的蛋白-蛋白结合模式，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但非TF-DNA，方法可迁移至互作界面建模，故评5分。
abstract: Tribbles pseudokinases, Tribbles homolog 1 (TRIB1), Tribbles homolog 2 (TRIB2), and Tribbles homolog 3 (TRIB3), bind to constitutive photomorphogenesis protein 1 (COP1) E3 ligase to mediate the regulation of beta-catenin expression. The interaction mechanism between COP1 E3 ligase and beta-catenin has not been addressed to date. Based on the functional presence of TRIBs in wingless-related integration site (WNT) signaling, we analyzed their interaction patterns with beta-catenin and COP1. Here, through in silico approaches, we ascribe the COP1 binding pattern against TRIBs and beta-catenin. TRIB1 (355-DQIVPEY-361), TRIB2 (326-DQLVPDV-332), and TRIB3 (333-AQVVPDG-339) peptides revealed a shallow binding pocket at the COP1 interface to accommodate the V-P sequence motif. Reinvigoration of the comparative binding pattern and subtle structural analysis via docking, molecular dynamics simulations, molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann surface area, topological, and tunnel analysis revealed that both beta-catenin phosphodegron (DSGXXS) and TRIB (D/E/AQXVPD/E) motifs occupied a common COP1 binding site. Current study suggests a structural paradigm of TRIB homologs bearing a conserved motif that may compete with beta-catenin phosphodegron signature for binding to WD40 domain of COP1. Thorough understanding of the structural basis for TRIB-mediated regulation of WNT/beta-catenin signaling may help in devising more promising therapeutic strategy for liver and colorectal cancers.
abstract_zh: Tribbles假激酶，Tribbles同源物1（TRIB1）、Tribbles同源物2（TRIB2）和Tribbles同源物3（TRIB3），与组成型光形态建成蛋白1（COP1）E3连接酶结合，以介导β-catenin表达的调控。迄今为止，COP1 E3连接酶与β-catenin之间的相互作用机制尚未被阐明。基于TRIBs在无翅型相关整合位点（WNT）信号传导中的功能性存在，我们分析了它们与β-catenin和COP1的相互作用模式。在此，通过计算机模拟方法，我们确定了COP1与TRIBs及β-catenin的结合模式。TRIB1（355-DQIVPEY-361）、TRIB2（326-DQLVPDV-332）和TRIB3（333-AQVVPDG-339）肽段在COP1界面揭示了一个浅结合口袋，以容纳V-P序列基序。通过对接、分子动力学模拟、分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积、拓扑及通道分析，对比较结合模式和细微结构分析的重新强化表明，β-catenin磷酸化降解子（DSGXXS）和TRIB（D/E/AQXVPD/E）基序均占据了一个共同的COP1结合位点。当前研究提出了一个结构范式，即TRIB同源物携带一个保守基序，该基序可能竞争β-catenin磷酸化降解子特征，以结合COP1的WD40结构域。深入理解TRIB介导的WNT/β-catenin信号调控的结构基础，可能有助于为肝癌和结直肠癌制定更有前景的治疗策略。
